ShortDescription.Value: DEV TEST BUILD of Traffic: Clear the Way. Unstable - do not use on a city you care about.

Publish.LongDescription:
⚠️ **This is the development build of _Traffic: Clear the Way_. It is not the mod you want.**
Install the normal release instead - this page exists so testers can try changes before they ship.
- Expect rough edges: unfinished behaviour, debug logging, values that change between uploads. - Do **not** run it on a city you care about. Keep a backup save. - Never run it alongside the release version - both register the same systems.
Feedback on a dev build is most useful with `Logs/ClearTheWay.log` attached (switch on "Verbose logging" in the options first).
Release version: https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/151583/Windows
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.1.13.1 - compatibility build for game 1.6.2f1.
No behaviour changes. This is 0.1.13.0 rebuilt against "Autumn Breeze" (1.6.2f1, released 2026-09-15) and re-checked against it.
**What was checked** - The mod compiles clean against the 1.6.2 assemblies: none of the game API it binds to was removed or changed. - The three places a clean build says nothing about were verified by hand - the private field `PrefabSystem.m_Prefabs` (still a list of PrefabBase), `EntityManager.CreateEntity(EntityArchetype)` which is called through reflection, and the `RoadMaintenanceDepot01` / `RoadMaintenanceVehicle01` prefabs the tow depot and the tow truck are cloned from. All three are unchanged in 1.6.2. - Nothing in the 1.6.2 patch notes touches emergency vehicles, accidents, lanes, pathfinding or crossings. The vehicle fixes it does carry are about parking and transit stations, not the despawn paths this mod shields.
**Not in this build** The extended towing escalation - full rights for a recovery vehicle that has been wedged for a minute, convoy discipline behind a standing colleague, and arrival assist for ordinary maintenance vans - is not finished and is deliberately left out. It sits on its own branch and lands in a later build.
**What to report** Anything that behaves differently under 1.6.2 than it did under 1.6.0, particularly traffic around an accident: 1.6.2 changed when the game cleans vehicles up, and that is the area this mod shields.
